name: camoufox
description: Camoufox: the anti-detect Firefox build and its Playwright launcher. The camoucore/camoufox launcher under its own name.
//: A release wrapper, not the launcher: everything comes from camoucore/camoufox in the one camoucore package (https://github.com/CamouBrowser/camoucore), pinned to one exact version (keep it equal to the root pyproject.toml's; ci/release.py checks), laid out as camoucore's RELEASING.md, 'The wrapper packages', says. This adds camoufox_pin/browser-pin.json, stamped by .github/workflows/release.yml with the browser release built from the same sources (a copy of the root camoufox_pin/browser-pin.json), read as camoufox/camoufox_pin/browser-pin.json. Packed from this directory, so the tarball carries this directory's MIT LICENSE, not the repository's.
